title: Clinical application of the perforator flap pedicled with the superficial branch of the superficial circumflex iliac artery in head and neck reconstruction surgery
html: The superficial circumflex iliac artery (SCIA) perforator flap is supplied by the SCIA, which consists of superficial and deep branches. In this study, the feasibility of using a flap based solely on the superficial branch of the SCIA for reconstruction surgery in the head and neck region was explored. During flap harvesting, the deep branch of the SCIA was discarded, and the superficial branch was dissected as the vascular pedicle; this technique is referred to as the ‘simplified SCIA flap. This simplified SCIA flap was used to repair head and neck defects in 16 patients, all of whom were followed up for at least 3 months postoperatively.
